themes.name: Critical thinking enhancement through AI-mediated pedagogy
themes.definition: Studies focusing on AI's capacity to develop reflective reasoning and analytical skills via structured questioning, feedback, and cognitive scaffolding. Themes often intersect with active learning strategies and learner autonomy.
evidence: [Favero2025] Results indicate that the Socratic tutor supports the development of reflection and critical thinking significantly better than standard chatbots
[Lee2025a] GPT-CMDP students had significantly higher... critical thinking and problem-solving skills than the C-CMDP group
[Hönigsberg2025] support critical thinking through hands-on engagement

themes.name: Generative AI integration in pedagogical frameworks
themes.definition: Systematic incorporation of tools like ChatGPT into structured educational models, emphasizing enhanced knowledge acquisition, skill development, and procedural scaffolding within discipline-specific contexts.
evidence: [Kurniawan2025a] AI-enhanced DPBBL model effectively supports active learning and practical problem-solving
[Lin2025c] AI-based procedural scaffolding with peer assessment in flipped classrooms

themes.name: Ethical and metacognitive implications of AI dependence
themes.definition: Investigation of risks associated with AI reliance in education, including cognitive offloading, skill atrophy, and ethical challenges around academic integrity, complemented by strategies for responsible AI engagement.
evidence: [Waziana2025] expressed concerns about risks such as cognitive offloading and skill atrophy
[Anwar2025] reinforced understanding of academic integrity...enhanced critical thinking
[Tian2025] information literacy buffered the negative impact of AI dependence on critical thinking

themes.name: Domain-specific AI applications in technical education
themes.definition: Contextual implementation of AI tools within STEM and healthcare disciplines to address domain-specific challenges in knowledge transfer, clinical reasoning, and technical skill development.
evidence: [Kim2025] Promoting awareness of ethical implications of AI in laboratory decision-making
[Dubovský2026] AI-assisted educational tool for digital histopathology improving diagnostic training
[Liu2025] AI-driven knowledge visualization enhancing clinical reasoning in surgical nursing

themes.name: Pedagogical value of human-AI collaboration
themes.definition: Exploration of synergies between human instructors and AI tutors in achieving balanced cognitive development, ethical oversight, and personalized learning experiences.
evidence: [DMello2012] Affective AutoTutor shows improvements by detecting emotional states
[Hönigsberg2025] Underscored continued importance of human educators in ethical guidance
[Fang2026] Teacher support enhanced competence satisfaction and critical thinking

data.meta_observations: Critical thinking and generative AI integration dominate as recurring themes across disciplines. There's a notable tension between AI's cognitive benefits and its ethical/structural limitations. Methodological consistency is constrained by abstract quality issues (no quantitative data in 18/26 entries). Many studies adopt quasi-experimental designs with small N (<50 participants) in specialized domains.
data.grounding_notes: All themes anchored to verbatim citations. Some abstracts (e.g., DMello2012, Patel2025) contributed to multiple themes due to their comprehensive scope. Frequency assessments consider article overlap across themes.
